historical_evidence.finding: A play-type classifier assisted-flag leak gave SPOT_UP 2.83 PPP and TRANSITION 0.62 PPP because the assisted flag exists only on makes. After the rewrite, SPOT_UP was about 1.16 and TRANSITION about 1.20.

OTHER possessions ended in fouls 36% of the time, which inflated PPP. DRIVE was 12pp below the foul benchmark. PNR showed a 22% foul rate. Only 335 of 50,668 possessions (0.7%) mapped to a real play type via initiation_type.

Label accuracy and distribution audit recorded overall FAIL (verdict tool_eval_fail). OTHER was 20.2% against a <10% target, 40.8% of labels were low confidence, DRIVE foul-draw was 1.7% against a 14-22% benchmark, most play types had PPP above the benchmark band, and MIA identity checks failed.

Backfill verification failed: PNR share was 28.7% against a 20-28% band, PULL_UP was 7.9%, 3100 games had team PNR above 33%, team identity checks failed, and 2024-25 PULL_UP was about 0-1% for many teams. 82.8% of PNR labels were proxy_calibrated. Final verdict: FAIL. PNR PPP of 0.948 passed. Sample was 921,514 possessions.

Downstream opponent next-PPP effects were real for 4 of 8 play types: CUT 1.658 (suppression +0.0220), TRANSITION 1.509 (+0.0145), SPOT_UP 1.303 (+0.0124), POST_UP 1.127 (+0.0194). DRIVE was not real. Player-level downstream effects were mostly not significant after Benjamini-Hochberg (BH). Effects were about 0.01-0.02 PPP, small relative to direct PPP gaps.

Opponent PUTBACK was the top preceding-play suppressor for 6+ stars (D. Mitchell 1.178 to 0.884, d=-0.294, n_after=95; B. Beal d=-0.345, n=32; C. Holmgren d=-0.222, n=52). Other top cells were TRANSITION (A. Davis -0.058) and POST_UP (N. Jokic -0.075). No multiplicity correction was applied. Minimum n_after was 30.

Raw lag-1 opponent PPP after a star's second Q1/Q2 foul was +0.204 CI[+0.163,+0.245]. This was an artifact of free-throw share (41.8% treated vs 9.9% control). Excluding free throws, lag-1 was +0.0486 [-0.0060,+0.0991], permutation p=0.0655. Lag-2 was -0.0192 and lag-3 was -0.0272. No lag cleared CI, permutation, and placebo together. n_treated lag-1 was 2101.

Across playoff series game buckets, DRIVE PPP rose 0.889 to 0.949 (+0.060), with CUT +0.114, PNR +0.087, PULL_UP -0.077, POST_UP -0.032. The record reports no clear signal. It is observational, has selection caveats, has no CIs, and covers 1197 records.

On-ball defensive scheme labels (DROP/ICE/SWITCH) were confidently labeled for 14.9% of DET on-ball possessions (10 of 67) and 3.3% of ORL possessions (2 of 60). switches_on was unpopulated in the NBA matchups feed. Verdict: failed_gate.

Inferred defensive scheme changes were 61.0% within game and 67.7% across games, with 99% of units showing a change. Transition matrices were near-uniform, consistent with label noise. The inferred label cannot separate real defensive adjustment from offense executing differently.

design.estimand: Among opponent possessions following play X by the same team, the difference in opponent next-possession PPP between X and matched non-X sequences, after removing foul and free-throw endings and conditioning on baseline. Own-sequence lags 1-3 are secondary.
design.unit: Possession pair (play X possession, following opponent possession), with fouls and free throws excluded or modeled separately.
design.sample: Pilot on 2024-25 regular season with a labeling audit first. Expand to 2022-23 to 2025-26 regular season only after label validation passes. Exclude 2025-26 playoffs and partial 2025-26 regular season until complete. Use play types with at least 1,000 possession pairs.
design.power: Pre-specify a minimum detectable effect (for example 0.02 PPP) and compute n per play type with a two-sided alpha of 0.05 and 80% power. Any cell below the threshold is reported as underpowered, not null.
design.controls: Remove or model foul and free-throw endings. Match on baseline opponent PPP, score margin, period, and clock. Build labels without any next-possession outcome field. Audit the assisted-flag and initiation_type fields for lookahead. Use within-team or within-player baselines where possible.
design.falsification: Placebo lags (lag -1, lag -2) and placebo play types (a play type with no hypothesized effect) must show null effects. A label-shuffle placebo must also show null. The effect must survive removal of fouls and free throws.
design.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across play types and lags, with the family defined in the pre-registration. Report adjusted and unadjusted results. No cell is reported as a finding without the adjusted result.
design.decision_rule: Declare an effect real only if the BH-adjusted 95% CI excludes zero, the effect exceeds the pre-specified minimum (about 0.02 PPP), the placebo lags and play types are null, and the result survives foul/free-throw removal and label-shuffle checks. Otherwise report as inconclusive or artifact. Define the AVOID threshold in advance; do not set it after seeing effect sizes.
design.data_version: NBA stats API per-game files, 2024-25 regular season first (label validation pilot), then 2022-23 to 2025-26 regular season once label checks pass. Exclude partial 2025-26 data and the 2025-26 playoffs until complete.
